posts.description: Matt Birchler asks , as a Mastodon advocate (as we are too), “what makes it so that almost everyone who joins Mastodon gives up on it?” I bring all this up because when well known individuals make a choice to post on X again, or to leave Mastodon, we hear about it and it becomes The Discourse for a bit. I think the more worrying thing is that these are not outliers, they’re doing the same thing 90
Feedhouse is a new-to-me browser-based RSS reader with sharing, newsletter subscribing, search, read-later, and, importantly, no algorithms.
